# netskope_device_classification_steering_mapping (Resource)

DeviceClassificationSteeringMapping Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netskope_device_classification_steering_mapping" "my_deviceclassificationsteeringmapping" {
  onprem_detection_ids = [
    8
  ]
  steering_id = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `onprem_detection_ids` (List of Number) On-prem detection label IDs to map to this steering config (replaces existing mappings). Hook unwraps to bare array before sending to API. Requires replacement if changed.
- `steering_id` (Number) Requires replacement if changed.

### Read-Only

- `data` (List of Number) On-prem detection label IDs associated with the steering config
- `status` (Boolean)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = netskope_device_classification_steering_mapping.my_netskope_device_classification_steering_mapping
  id = 0
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netskope_device_classification_steering_mapping.my_netskope_device_classification_steering_mapping 0
```
